verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides infrastructure for background automation—webhooks for async event notifications, JIT funding for automated real-time funding decisions, and velocity/authorization controls that enforce spend rules autonomously—plus an MCP server letting AI agents create cards, query data, and set spend controls without manual intervention. However, this is transaction-processing automation rather than a general AI-native 'set up and forget' automation/workflow builder, and there's no evidence of scheduled or persistent autonomous agent runs beyond on-demand MCP queries. Missing for 10: a dedicated workflow/automation scheduler for persistent background AI tasks, and independent evidence of agents operating unattended over time.
